context:
Goal: no buyer names left lying in scratch folders once the Orders hunt is done.
Problem (cannot undo): the hunt's traces and video folders hold buyer names and have no copy, so a delete cannot be undone.
Based on (read): the Orders lane says its 9 findings are written up in its handoff, and nothing in the lane reads the traces.
Departs from: the traces and video folders in the Orders lane's scratchpad (session 72b8b5ec) — they would be deleted.
Waiting on: nothing stopped; the Orders lane deletes or keeps them on your answer.
Your answer (chat, 19:50 CST Nov 22): keep them. "Old hunt traces -- those are totally okay to keep, in general buyer names is generally fine to keep on this device/repo." The folders stay.

lastAnswer.note: Old hunt traces are okay to keep; buyer names are fine to keep on this device and repo.
